7693.title: Repeated preview mapping discards stable row identity
7693.rootCauseOneLine: Preview shortening remaps stable input rows on every build, allocating replacement leaves and ancestors before structural reuse deep-compares and restores the prior subtree.

prReviews.topFinding: The cache targets repeated subtree mapping; no linked PR code was executed.

7693.proposedFix: Cache transformed subtrees by immutable input row identity and transformation options; avoid a duplicate PR while #7700 remains open.
7693.caveats: No live-stream benchmark; runtime impact unmeasured. Verification was repeated by the same agent. Full reproduction is inline; raw evidence remains local per public reports policy.
